dbt MCP server (semantic layer tools, text_to_sql tool)

dimensions.n: Semantic models declare dimensions. Detail page was not read this session.

relationships.n: Semantic models declare entities used to join. Detail page was not read this session.

vendors.name: Cube (Core and Cloud, D3)
vendors.tagline: Semantic layer with cubes and views, plus a Cloud agent platform (D3) and MCP.
vendors.verdictNote: Cubes, views, access policies, certified queries, a chat API, a hosted MCP server, and Ossie import and export are documented.

artifacts.name: Chat API (AI API) for Cube agents

metrics.n: Measures are declared in cubes. Views expose them to consumers.

dimensions.n: Dimensions are declared in cubes and included in views.

relationships.n: Directed joins such as many_to_one between cubes. Views use join_path.

synonyms.n: Agents take rules and accessible views as configuration. A dedicated synonym field was not confirmed.

verifiedQueries.n: Agent configuration supports certified queries. Status label not seen.

nl2sql.n: D3 AI Data Analyst and the Chat API answer questions over the semantic layer. Launched June 2025.

ontology.n: No ontology layer found. Cubes and views are the modeling objects.

vector.n: No vector search found in the pages seen.

mcp.n: Hosted remote MCP server with OAuth, listed as available on all plans in Cube docs. Local server is deprecated.

governance.n: Row-level security, data access policies, and user attributes are enforced by Cube, not by the agent.

openStandard.n: Export and import Apache Ossie models through the Cube CLI and Platform API (changelog 16 Oct 2026).

offers: Cubes and views give agents a curated, joined model with measures and dimensions defined once.
Hosted MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor query governed data.
Chat API runs Cube agents with rules, certified queries, and chosen views.
Access policies and row-level security apply to agent queries.
Ossie import and export moves models in and out of Cube.
gaps: Cube only reads SQL-queryable sources, per the data sources page.
D3 and the Chat API carry no GA or beta label in the pages seen.
Agent UI configuration is deprecated in favor of code-first setup, per Chat API docs.
No ontology, graph, or vector feature found.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Model cubes and views on your warehouse, then expose a small set of views to an agent. Use the hosted MCP server or the Chat API. Add rules and certified queries in the agent configuration.

notes.text: Vendor-run by dbt Labs. Dataset: ACME Insurance (from data.world), 11 questions run 20 times each, dated 7 Apr 2026 by secondary sources. On modeled questions, Claude Sonnet 4.6 went from 90.0% (text-to-SQL) to 98.2% (semantic layer), and GPT-5.3-Codex from 84.1% to 100.0%. Overall figures for the full question set were reported inconsistently, so they are not given here.

notes.text: Vendor-run by Cube employees (blog and arXiv paper). Dataset: Cleaned Contoso Retail in ClickHouse, 100 questions. Schema only vs schema plus a 4 KB hand-written markdown semantic doc: Opus 4.7 50.5% to 67.7%, Sonnet 4.6 46.5% to 68.7%, GPT-5.4 45.5% to 68.7%. The semantic layer here is a markdown file, not a running Cube deployment. Publication date was not confirmed.

notes.topic: Apache Ossie status for these vendors
notes.text: OSI is renamed Apache Ossie (incubating). Cube shipped Ossie import and export on 16 Oct 2026. Honeydew docs describe import and export. AtScale joined OSI on 27 Jan 2026. dbt Labs co-leads, and a dbt converter is reported merged. No Ossie support was found for Wren or Malloy.
